evidence.quote: Fees and expenses would be separately paid, subject to court approval; any amount not awarded would benefit the class rather than revert to Brightline.

evidence.agent: Hargrove Lane LLP declaration to court
evidence.quote: The parties discussed class relief and attorneys’ fees during the same negotiations; fees were not deferred until after agreement on class relief.
We can hold fees and expenses at $4.25 million, subject to court approval, if Brightline increases the class fund to $31.5 million.

summary: Plaintiffs raised fee terms in their opening proposals, and fees were negotiated alongside class relief before final settlement. There is explicit fee-relief linkage because Hargrove offered to hold fees at $4.25 million if the class fund increased. The transcript does not clearly show class counsel prioritizing its own fees over the class, defense leveraging fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
